description:
Walk a single file's AST and produce its `Requirement`s with their `Check`s. Requirement = an H1 whose text matches `^(Requirement|Req) ` (`Req` is an alias); the remainder of the line is the title. Check = an H2 whose text matches `^Check `, associated with the nearest preceding requirement; the Markdown beneath it is the prompt.

———
